display_title: I Am the Wicked Woman Desired by His Tyrant Majesty
description:
*“You, too, will be corrupted. Then I will make it all come true.”* 

If I had only joined hands with him and agreed to become his mistress then, could I have lived a little longer? At least I would not have know the pain of my eyes being gouged out. But instead I shouted: “I refuse. I will not betray my country”, not realizing that my country, my family, had betrayed me long ago.

Sacrificed, used, abandoned, and finally executed by my own family... I only realized after returning to 10 years in the past that the reason why you wanted me to stand by your side is because you and I were so much alike. Let us fall together this time.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Won first place in the Tateyomi Manga Awards 2025 domestic category.*
